items.project_definition: The interface providing endpoints for external data retrieval and system interaction, documented via Swagger/OpenAPI.
The security layer verifying identity via a specific header to grant access to protected resources.
The specific credential format required within the request header for identity verification.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for communication between the frontend and backend.
The compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties, secured by a strong secret key.
The abstraction layer provided by Sequelize to manage relational data without writing raw queries.
The standard language used to define and manipulate the relational schema in PostgreSQL.
The system actor granted specific privileges to interact with the persistent storage.
The command used to resolve and download project dependencies for both the client and server.
The execution script used to launch the application in production or development mode.
The command used to trigger the automated validation suite for both the frontend and backend.
